Star Wars: Galactic Racer™ | Under the Hood with Hibi – Podracers
What’s got our expert Ardennian engineer Hibi so excited?
 
It’s podracers!
 
In this video, Shade’s energetic mechanic and ardent supporter enthuses about the unparalleled speed and velocity of these galactic racing behemoths. Breakneck speed, ridiculous velocity, and no room for error. Think you’re ready to pilot one of the most iconic vehicles in the Star Wars galaxy?
 
Star Wars: Galactic Racer launches worldwide on October 6th. Pre-order today for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
 
Visit the official website to pre-order today:
Official Site - URL https://starwarsgalacticracer.com/
